accepted_findings: Selected v2 scale 0.24 / gain 0.55 after comparing four actual native-render trials with supplied front and rear photographs
Crossed check groups remain clear at phone size without the dense regular band count of the superseded reconstruction
Lapel sampling follows existing seams; no artificial chest UV join
Photographic color target, native folds, original garment geometry and approved avatar retained
Final compiled runtime native frame exactly equals the selected diagnostic trial

rejected_trials.reason: Over-strong surface and conspicuous horizontal ribbing at phone size.
Crosshatch too pronounced; the legacy rectangular lapel mapping exposed a false horizontal chest join.
Check groups too large and pronounced at phone size.
Re-review found over-regular horizontal bands and compressed rectangular check groups at phone size.
Crossed groups compressed into too many busy bands at phone size.
Main check groups larger than the selected photographic match.
Fine pattern visibility was insufficient at phone size.

Generated reconstruction supplies luminance texture only
Visual review is separate from functional and publication validation
